# Lang Reader Guide

## Get Started

- **Language filter:** Select the languages you use and drag to reorder them. This controls the choices in language menus; languages specified in your document remain available.
- **Your notes:** Import files or folders, or create a Draft and paste your content. Supported files: `.md`, `.txt`, `.csv`, `.tsv`.
- **Mode:** Choose Reader for articles and notes, or Vocabulary for word lists and tables. Study adds Learn, Recall, and Dictation to Vocabulary.
- **Speech:** Choose a voice for each reading language. Audio uses your browser/system's text-to-speech voices, including Apple, Google, and Microsoft where available. Voice availability depends on your browser and device.

## Additional Notes

- **Keyboard shortcuts:** Click the keyboard icon at the top.
- **Inline translations `[translation]`:** In Reader, add translations after a word, phrase, or passage. **Translation […]** shows or hides them; the adjacent speaker controls whether they are read aloud.
- **External translation:** The links at the bottom right open selected text in Google Translate, DeepL, Microsoft Translator, or Baidu Translate.

Source code and local deployment: [https://github.com/yich-hao/lang-reader](https://github.com/yich-hao/lang-reader)
